title: ZMeta Event Schema v1.1.0
description: Extension of ZMeta v1.0. Adds modality-specific feature schemas, structured quality block, error ellipse, expanded task types, orbit geometry, SENSOR_STATUS, PLATFORM_STATUS, and strict UUIDv7 event identity.

utcDateTime.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp serialized with a trailing Z

event_subtype.description: Semantic subtype. Must match the payload discriminator for the event type.

frame.description: Optional explicit assertion of the canonical bearing reference frame. Canonical bearings are always degrees true north; any other frame label is invalid so mislabeled sensor-native frames fail validation.

orientation_deg.description: Orientation of the semi-major axis in degrees from true north

measurement_error.description: Self-describing measurement error with explicit unit and metric

calibration_state.description: Sensor calibration status at time of observation

geo_status.description: Provenance of the geo position. UNAVAILABLE means no GPS fix. CONFIGURED means position injected from config (GPS-denied). ESTIMATED means derived from dead reckoning or other indirect source.

bearing_frame.description: Frame provenance assertion for the canonical bearing. Describes the canonical bearing only and permits exactly TRUE_NORTH; raw sensor-native angles carry their frame in explicitly named payload-scoped fields instead.

heading_source.description: Heading reference used for true-north compensation, e.g. AHRS_TRUE, GPS_COURSE, FIXED_MOUNT_SURVEYED.

lobe_separation_m.description: Distance between lobes for figure-8 patterns

arc_degrees.description: Arc sweep in degrees for arc patterns

ref_id.description: Unique identifier within the referenced store

format.description: Data format (e.g. iq, wav, mp4, pcap, npy)

hash.description: Canonical SHA-256 content hash in the form sha256:<64 hex chars>

roi_px.description: Raw image region of interest or crop in pixels; not a detected object box

fov_deg.description: Camera field of view in degrees

spl_db.description: Sound pressure level in dB SPL re 20 uPa

duration_ms.description: Duration of the acoustic event in milliseconds

bandwidth_hz.description: Bandwidth of the acoustic signal in Hz

signature_hash.description: Hash of measured acoustic signature or feature vector

protocol.description: Network protocol (e.g. TCP, UDP, ICMP, HTTP, DNS, BLE, WiFi)

source_addr.description: Source address (IP, MAC, or other identifier)

sensor_id.description: Identifier of the sensor being reported

mode.description: Current sensor mode (e.g. SCAN, TRACK, DF, STARE)

fov_deg.description: Current field of view in degrees

endurance_remaining_ms.description: Estimated remaining flight/operation time in milliseconds

power_state.description: Current platform power source or power condition

flight_mode.description: Current flight/operation mode (e.g. AUTO, GUIDED, LOITER, RTL, MANUAL)

fuel_remaining_pct.description: Fuel remaining as percentage (for non-electric platforms)

retaskable.description: Whether this platform accepts retasking commands
